as_told.title: Richat Structure as Plato's Atlantis
as_told.place_text: Richat Structure (Eye of the Sahara), Mauritania

plain: A man named Jimmy Corsetti has argued that Atlantis, the lost island city in Plato's writings, was the Richat Structure, a huge ring-shaped formation in the desert of Mauritania. Michels mentions it in passing, saying Corsetti put the theory forward and naming the podcaster Joe Rogan alongside him. The researcher Graham Hancock takes it more cautiously. He says, "I get that the ring structure resembles how Plato described Atlantis," but goes on to qualify the claim. If true, it would place Plato's story on a real spot of land.
